objective: Find small, falsifiable changes that improve robustness without re-mining the locked historical confirmation set.
locked_constraints: Do not tune on the locked 2021-2023 historical confirmation results.
Do not use future returns, OOS labels, or test labels as proposal inputs.
Do not lower execution-cost assumptions to manufacture profitability.
Do not propose live order placement or exchange credentials.
Every LLM-generated hypothesis counts as a multiple-testing trial even if later rejected.
Prefer one-variable changes that reuse existing V3 helpers before adding new dependencies.
promotion_principle: A V4 candidate must be selected without seeing the locked confirmation labels, then survive frozen cost and delay stress before any paper-trading consideration.
